strategy.name: Inherited nuclei plus old marginal terranes and dated gateways
strategy.reason: It preserves the visibly different six-body envelopes while eliminating the two artificial devices that caused the prior historical failure: the late-looking C2 rigid offset and pasted Earth-reference guard sectors.

motion_policy.alternate_frame_role: MULLER2022 is a sensitivity check where the deep-time frame materially diverges; it is not silently mixed into the primary reconstruction.
motion_policy.rule: Relative rotations needed for silhouette design must finish before the human-route ledger begins. Local uplift, subsidence, erosion, volcanism, and sea-level response may continue afterward.

crustal_units.kind: composite continental nucleus and accreted margins
old craton in south-polar Proposal 4 position
crustal_units.provenance_status: paleolatitude scaffold supported; local plate boundaries unresolved

crustal_units.kind: continental shelf block with rifted and accreted margins
old continental nucleus now near equatorial latitudes
crustal_units.provenance_status: paleolatitude scaffold supported; biotic history unresolved

present_geometry_controls.coordinate_frame: reference/source coordinates prior to Proposal 4 rotation
notes: JX1 is intentionally oblique and broad rather than an Earth-Panama copy.
The C4 corridor moves the ancestral exit to a lower-latitude marginal route instead of the approximately 60S old exit anchor.
The C5 shelf head reaches the shelf-cradle locator while retaining a water gap to the first island block.

features.kind: composite accreted terrane / narrow continental junction
features.present_state: emergent narrow land connection with rugged volcanic and erosional bottlenecks
uncertainties: passability requires paleotopography, hydroclimate, and local sea-level reconstruction

features.present_state: not required to be a continuous present-day land bridge
uncertainties: exact sill depths and H06/H10 exposure windows require sea-level and isostatic reconstruction

features.kind: second accessibility window on old substrate
accreted/retained continental foreland and coastal corridor
features.replaces_reference_route: old ancestral exit near source (32,30), approximately 60S native latitude at 2 Ma
uncertainties: glacial extent and habitat productivity along the margin require climate/ice modeling

features.kind: ice-free or seasonally productive peripheral habitat network

features.present_state: mainland shelf head; not connected to the first deep-water island
uncertainties: paleobathymetric elevations of shelf surfaces and sills

accessibility_states.mode: rare small bidirectional contacts through a persistent bottleneck
second land/coastal opening; coastal and mountain-rim entry first

unresolved_constraints.question: Can C4 maintain productive peripheral refugia through the required 2 Ma to later intervals without opening an implausible ice-free polar interior?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Do not redraw the continent further to answer this; resolve with a climate/ice and elevation model.

unresolved_constraints.question: What sill-depth history produces distinct H06 and H10 northern access windows while avoiding a permanent easy corridor?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with bathymetry, eustasy, isostasy, and local tectonic sensitivity; do not invent a new continent-scale rotation.

unresolved_constraints.question: Do the eastern deep-water channels remain sufficiently deep through H03/H09 while nearby shelves expose enough route area for H02/H04?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with a dated paleobathymetric cross-section and crossing-distance audit.

unresolved_constraints.question: Can C3 topography create intermittent western/eastern contact without a permanent low-friction bypass?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with relief/drainage/climate reconstruction, not coastline changes unless that model specifically requires them.

unresolved_constraints.question: What exact plate/block partition generates all six final envelopes while preserving crustal mass and old sutures?
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Requires a dedicated plate reconstruction; the current graph constrains but does not simulate it.

fallback_strategy.trigger: Use only if Strategy A later fails a dated geometry or plate-block test that cannot be repaired locally.
fallback_strategy.description: Promote the C1-C2 junction to a separately reconstructed microplate and permit modest pre-1.9 Ma rotations of both adjacent bodies around it.
fallback_strategy.retry_limit: one materially different fallback after Strategy A; preserve the best valid state if B also fails
